in_marathi.name: Haradhan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God Hara's giver
in_marathi.long_meaning: Haradhan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। This name is derived from the Sanskrit language, and it refers to the one who offers or gives to the god Hara. Haradhan is a name of great significance in Hindu mythology, where Hara is the god of fertility, growth, and prosperity.
